verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Groq is OpenAI-compatible and documents a models list page (models.md) describing available models, but nowhere is there explicit documentation of a GET /v1/models-style endpoint or API for programmatic catalog enumeration; probes for openapi specs returned 404s. missing for 10: explicit /v1/models endpoint documentation, API reference for listing models, and any confirmation that the base_url compatibility exposes a live model-catalog endpoint.
